text: 刘晓，孔妍，崔一民，梁雁( 北京大学第一医院药剂科，北京 100034)LIU Xiao，KONG Yan，CUI Yi － min，LIANG Yan( Department of Pharmacy，Peking University First Hospital， Beijing 100034， China)Abstract: Objective To analyze 3 cases of adverse drug reactions caused by drug interactions. Methods We selected the adverse drug reactions induced by drug interactions from the summary of 1003 cases of adverse drug reactions reported in our hospital during 2010 － 2014，and analyzed and evaluated the cases one by one. Results There were 3 cases of the adverse drug reactions due to drug interactions in the all 1003 cases of adverse drug reactions. One case was a patient given voriconazole combined with cyclosporine leading to the cyclosporine plasma concentration increased and the patient was limb － shaking. One case was a patient given spironolactone combined with digoxin leading to digoxin poisoning;
